user_request: Inspect the analysis tree and summarize the photon-related variables in plain language.

trajectory.content: Inspect the analysis tree and summarize the photon-related variables in plain language.

The file contains an analysis tree with four events and a one-dimensional cut-flow histogram. The photon-related branches are photon_n, a scalar count per event, and photon_pt and photon_eta, variable-length floating-point arrays holding one value per photon. The tool output establishes their structure but does not establish units, so no units are claimed.
